notes.title: 2024 - Development Continues!
notes.content:
We have been awfully quiet this year, we know! 😓 Several unexpected life situations have hit the development of the game hard as the pouring rain hits our characters in-game.

Despite these unforeseen troubles, and contrary to some shady sources online (do not trust these), we´re glad to inform you that the development of Noir Storm continues, slowly but steadily. 😎

What´s in store for next year, you wonder? The release of the official DEMO is imminent; we want players to get to know the prologue of the story while we work on Act One development, which is scheduled for release sometime next year on Steam.

The migration of the the entire Act One build, which was already playable on a custom-made system, to the robust Adventure Creator plugin for Unity has proven to be quite an odyssey, but the result is much better than our previous iteration; we could not be happier! 🤟🙂

notes.title: Mystery Fest is here and we are glad to take part !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095112/6f386374b7d70a20b4a04ddb6b61b9c107c14a43.gif[/img]

The Steam Mystery Festival celebrates the spirit [u]of investigation and mystery solving[/u] - whether big or small - with discounts and demos on mystery and detective games of all kinds, both current and upcoming releases.

This event will take place from February 20 at 19:00 (PST) until February 27 at the same time and will include discounts, as well as sections on upcoming releases and games with demos.


Seven days full of mysterious games Noir Storm seats proud with.
[b]Don´t forget to add the game to your wishlist, Playable Demo coming this year ![/b]

notes.title: Noir Storm participates on Tiny Teams Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095112/844b9012b83b207c7030bbe38f7c654e68ab5e33.png[/img]

We are happy to be a part of this year´s edition of [b]"Tiny Teams Steam Festival"[/b] by The Yogscast!

The Tiny Teams Fest- a festival especially for games made [u]by teams of 5 and under and hosted by Yogscast - is live now! [/u] It's a great way to discover exceptional games made by passionate, independent teams who have the leeway to experiment and bring fresh ideas to gaming. Many of them are on sale!

Visit the Festival by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival]Clicking Here[/url]

See you Under the Storm!

notes.title: June 2022 Devlog (#1)
notes.content:
Hello dearest Noir people! 
It´s been a while since we debut this here Steam Page, so we wanted to take this opportunity to tell you about things that are beign worked on for the upcoming ([i]heavily[/i]) improved upon DEMO.

There´s no concrete date of release but we hope it could bit as soon as possible.  

The [b]DEMO[/b] will feature the narrative hook of the game (45 minutes to an hour of gameplay time), comprising 900+ lines of voiced dialogue, presenting the characters and the seed of the plot. 

The languages supported so far are English and Spanish, but we are considering more languages!

[b][u]Stuff we are improving:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Tweaked visuals and scenario lightning
[*] New character animations
[*] Reworked some character sprites and portraits
[*] A system that highlights all interactive hotspots in the Scene
[*] Reworked and improved "notebook" mechanic and UI
[*] Saving and Loading now possible ([i]including autosave[/i])
[*] Gamma controls
[*] Fully Reworked UI 
[*] Better Cameras and cinematic feel
[/list]

Also ([i]not featured on the DEMO[/i]) but we wanted to share it as a BONUS) there´s the new MAP UI for traversing the City of the game, this Map is an historical representation of the Buenos Aires of 1952. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095112/356616d8eae907f92af15b9426b829e0e444958b.png[/img]
